description: Returns the exact x402 payment request for a bridge (network, asset, payTo contract, amount, EIP-712 domain) and the URL to call. Pay it with your own x402 client: sign one EIP-3009 authorization and repeat the GET with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. You receive exactly `amount` at your own address on the destination. This tool does not pay or sign anything.

amount.description: USDC to RECEIVE on the destination, e.g. "1" or "25.5". Minimum 1.

from.description: Chain you pay on. Omit to pick the live route to `to` (Base to any listed chain; Arc to Base).

ref.description: Optional referrer address: earns 20% of Liquid's fee. Omit if you have none.

to.description: Chain you receive on: arc, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, avalanche, unichain, linea, world, sonic, monad, sei, ink, hyperevm, xdc, plume, codex (from Base) or base (from Arc).

name: bridge_prepare_payment

url.description: URL to call with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header

x402.description: The x402 payment request (accepts: scheme, network, asset, payTo, amount, EIP-712 domain)

title: Prepare a bridge payment (x402)
